saint-vincent-and-the-grenadines.title: Flag of Saint Vincent and the Grenadines

colors.note: Hoist vertical band; represents the sky and the Caribbean sea.
Central vertical band; represents the warm sun and golden sands of the Grenadines.
Fly vertical band and the diamond-shaped V emblem; represents lush vegetation and the vitality of the people.

desc:
- A vertical triband of blue, gold (double width), and green, with three green diamonds arranged as a V on the gold central band
- The V of diamonds stands for Vincent and also recalls the Grenadines, often nicknamed the Gems of the Antilles
- Designed by Swiss graphic artist Julien van der Wal and adopted on 21 October 1985, replacing the original independence-era flag
trivia:
- The three diamonds representing the Grenadines are laid out as a V both for Vincent and for the island chain's chain of gems
- The Swiss designer Julien van der Wal created the 1985 revision; the current flag replaced the country's original 1979 independence banner
- The gold band is twice the width of each side band, producing the distinctive wide central emblem field
